firstPlayerRule: Whoever has traveled farthest north goes first.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: That player begins Phase One by rolling the die. Play then proceeds clockwise.
Phase Two begins on the next player's turn after the final ice block is removed.
